selection: All currently replay-parsed matches in the latest 50 ranked; filename retained as coverage grows.

methodology.missing: null and missing_fields; observed empty logs are []; n counts matches with observed values.
methodology.times: Seconds relative to match start. Exact 10/20/30-minute samples only. No interpolation or gold-for-net-worth substitution.
methodology.kda_ratio: (kills+assists)/deaths; null for zero deaths, while raw K/D/A remains available.
methodology.items: First observed purchase time for an explicit major-item allowlist in scripts/stories.py. No observed purchase does not mean time zero or prove an item was never owned.
methodology.events: Player deaths/buybacks and player stats within OpenDota teamfights; objectives are match-wide, not automatic player credit. Projected fields only; full source logs remain in source_json.
methodology.interpretation: Descriptive statistics, not causal or mistake classifications. Unknown intent, vision, and reasons for decisions are not reconstructed.
